name: Happy Path — Opt-In with Valid PRAN, Old Regime, Valid Contribution
goal: User enrolls for NPS, provides valid PRAN, selects Old Regime, and enters valid contribution percentage.
constraints: All inputs valid; PRAN is 12 digits; PRAN proof is PDF <5MB; tax regime is 'Old Regime'; contribution ≤10.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays employee details confirmation card.

phases.description: User enters valid PRAN and uploads valid PDF proof.
User selects 'Old Regime' and enters 9.5 as contribution.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot submits update and displays completion message.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
